notes: The seven named tests are in the right packages and would fail if the given socket path, mode 0660, effective gid, private inner socket, --admin-socket default, unit ownership, or the guarded groupadd were wrong. Existing-test edits stay inside the owner-allowed internal/proxy/proxy_test.go and memory_test.go and only move the socket to a short unique /tmp path and require mode 0660. TestAdminSocketModeAndGroup sets the setgid parent only when the process has another group, so a host with no extra group could still pass without Chown. The lifecycle_test.go hunk in the three-dot diff is the unrebased owner-allowance commit already on origin/main, not the test round.
